title: SkillDNA
subtitle: Your team solved this. Why start from zero?
narration: Your team keeps solving the same problem, but the method never sticks. Every new chat starts over.

title: Expertise gets buried. The cost repeats.
subtitle: Repeated context / Repeated corrections / Repeated tokens
narration: Repeated context, repeated corrections, wasted tokens. Expertise stays buried in old chats.

title: Keep the method, not just the conversation.
subtitle: SkillDNA / A local-first VS Code extension
narration: SkillDNA is a VS Code extension. It analyzes your approved sessions and turns repeated steps into a reusable Copilot skill.

title: One reviewed process. A head start for the team.
subtitle: Local-first / You approve / Optional Copilot review
narration: You choose what it sees. Sessions and files stay local. Nothing leaves your machine without approval.

title: 1. Privacy: choose how to discover workflows
subtitle: Real VS Code extension / Isolated synthetic demo
narration: In Privacy, choose imported sessions or VS Code activity. First, import.

title: 2. Import quickly. Review what matters.
subtitle: Pick a workspace and sample size / Synthetic session files
narration: Give permission, choose a workspace and sample. Here are the sessions. Review and approve before discovery.

title: 3. Observe new work, with permission
subtitle: Enable VS Code activity / Open and save a sample file
narration: Choose VS Code activity in Privacy. Enable observation, then open and save a file.

title: 4. Verify observation against what just happened
subtitle: Activity categories, not file contents / Review before saving
narration: Pause and check Sessions. Inspect and edit match the file we opened and saved. That's how we check the capture. Approve the evidence, then review a workflow.

title: 5. Turn the workflow into a skill
subtitle: Editable instructions + a consistent result template
narration: Generate a skill draft. Review the instructions and result template. Edit anything that needs improving.

title: 6. Check it. Approve it. Reuse it.
subtitle: Validated and approved / Export stays under your control
narration: Validate the files, then approve the draft. It's ready for export and reuse. You're in control.

title: Stop paying to rediscover the same process.
subtitle: Reuse instructions / Optional Copilot review / Team-ready skills
narration: Ship the method, not just the answer. Reuse instructions across chats. Copilot can review each workflow, so only the strongest reach your team.

title: SkillDNA
subtitle: Capture the method. Share the skill. Move forward together.
narration: Skill DNA. Capture the method. Share the skill. Move forward together.
